description: This file contains utility functions, type definitions, and configuration handling for Google API integrations within a larger project, including URL normalization, provider configuration normalization, and request setup for Google Generative AI services.

methods.name: normalizeGoogleApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a given base URL for Google API, ensuring correct path and removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: isGoogleGenerativeAiApi
methods.description: Checks if the provided API string is 'google-generative-ai'.

methods.name: normalizeGoogleGenerativeAiBaseUrl
methods.description: Wrapper for normalizeGoogleApiBaseUrl for Google Generative AI base URLs.

methods.name: resolveGoogleGenerativeAiTransport
methods.description: Resolves transport parameters for Google Generative AI API, normalizing base URL if needed.

methods.name: resolveGoogleGenerativeAiApiOrigin
methods.description: Returns the API origin URL by removing the '/v1beta' suffix.

methods.name: shouldNormalizeGoogleGenerativeAiProviderConfig
methods.description: Determines if Google Generative AI provider config should be normalized based on provider key and config.

methods.name: shouldNormalizeGoogleProviderConfig
methods.description: Determines if Google provider config should be normalized, including antigravity and generative AI.

methods.name: normalizeProviderModels
methods.description: Normalizes model IDs within a provider's models array using a provided normalization function.

methods.name: normalizeGoogleProviderConfig
methods.description: Normalizes Google provider configuration, including models and base URL.

methods.name: parseGeminiAuth
methods.description: Parses API key for Gemini, returning appropriate authorization headers.

methods.name: resolveGoogleGenerativeAiHttpRequestConfig
methods.description: Creates request configuration for Google Generative AI API calls, including headers and URL normalization.

methods.name: applyGoogleGeminiModelDefault
methods.description: Applies default Gemini model to configuration if not already set to the default.
